gloss: new idea; new design; utility model (patent)

definitions.gloss: new idea; new design; novel proposal
definitions.explanation: A newly devised idea, plan, or design. Also used in patent law as part of {実用|じつよう}{新案|しんあん} (utility model), a category of intellectual property covering minor inventions.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{新案|しんあん}が{採用|さいよう}された。
この{機械|きかい}は{実用|じつよう}{新案|しんあん}として{登録|とうろく}されている。
examples.english: This machine is registered as a utility model.

notes:
Compound of {新|しん} (new) + {案|あん} (plan, idea). Used in two registers: an everyday sense of 'new idea/proposal' and a legal sense in patent law.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新案|しんあん}を{出|だ}す: to put forward a new idea
- {実用|じつよう}{新案|しんあん}: utility model (patent category)
- {新案|しんあん}{特許|とっきょ}: utility model patent

LEGAL CONTEXT:
In Japanese patent law, {実用|じつよう}{新案|しんあん} (utility model) is a separate, lower-bar form of protection than {特許|とっきょ} (full patent) — typically for minor improvements to existing products.
